purpose: Record of the four Codex conditions on the headroom split: sessions, scores, the cause check on the schema-only conditions, the access audit, and where the invocation differs from the archived one.

sessions.packetsSameAsBuilt: the ten packets have the sha256 values of packets/packets_record.json and of solvers/build/query_writer

storedScopeValueInQueries.note: Every exploration query names a value the records store: all 297 SQL queries name whole_target; the Cypher queries name whole_target (177, on the disposition node) or document_disposition (120, on the resolution node). No schema-only query names either value (0 of 594).

schemaOnlyCauseCheck.status: added after the scores were seen; not part of the pre-registered reading rule, which asks for a miss classification only when query writers or Codex with exploration fall below the ceiling. No score of the four conditions is changed by it.
schemaOnlyCauseCheck.method: Each schema-only query holds exactly one scope condition with guessed values. The query is executed again (a) with the stored value added to that list (SQL) or the condition replaced by the stored one on the disposition node (Cypher), and (b) with the condition removed. Nothing else in the query is touched.
schemaOnlyCauseCheck.reading: The scope value is the only element the schema-only queries lack: with it every one of the 297 queries returns the gold rows in both languages.

flagsRead.exp_cy_RAN1: 1 entry: the Cypher regular-expression operator =~ in a helper query matches the home-folder pattern.
flagsRead.exp_cy_RAN2: 3 entries: wait tool calls with no receiver thread, no prompt and no agent state; the session holds no other tool call than command executions.
flagsRead.sch_cy_RAN1: 1 entry: =~ and the word requests (from the question text 'change requests') in the script that writes the query file.
flagsRead.sch_cy_RAN2: 2 entries: the word requests from the question text in the query-writing script.
flagsRead.sch_cy_RAN3: 2 entries: the word requests from the question text in the query-writing script.

accessAudit.reading: No flagged entry reaches outside the working folder. The relational copies keep the sha256 of the originals before and after each exploration session, and the node and relationship counts of the five graphs are the same before and after.

differencesFromArchivedInvocation: One script runs both access conditions. The schema-only sessions use the archived schema-only prompts and the exploration sessions the archived exploration prompts and helper, with the same Codex command line (model, reasoning effort, sandbox).
Schema-only sessions: the event log and stderr are written outside the working folder (as the archived exploration sessions do); the archived schema-only sessions wrote them inside it.
A name is skipped when its run record already holds a prompt; the archived schema-only script skipped a name when its query file was non-empty. No name was skipped in this run.
Run records and query files are written under the headroom folder; archived records are left as they are.

readingOfThePlan.partSizeOfTheAdmittedSet: Read as the largest part of the admitted set (47 items), fixed before any score was seen: --max-part-size 47 gives ten parts (RAN1 30/30, RAN2 30/30, RAN3 29/29, RAN4 30/29, RAN5 30/30). These parts serve the text-search and dense sessions, which have not run yet.
